Task T3 is complete.

**Summary:**
- `out/T3/solution.py` — a plain script on `torch`+`safetensors` (the only packages in condition F that expose this exact per-tensor dtype/deletion/sharding policy) that loads the input checkpoint, casts the 64 named projection matrices to bfloat16, upcasts everything else to float32, deletes the 48 non-parameter buffers, runs the four required pre-write checks (fails loudly if any don't hold), then greedily packs tensors into ≤256 MiB shards — with `embed_in.weight`/`embed_out.weight` each alone in their own oversized shard — and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- `out/T3/run.sh` — invokes it.
- Ran once, succeeded first try: 196 tensors, 9 shards, 64 bfloat16 tensors, embeddings float32.
- I independently re-verified the output afterward (not part of the script's own checks): every shard ≤256 MiB except the two standalone embedding shards, `weight_map` covers exactly the 196 keys, and every surviving tensor is bit-exact against the source under its expected dtype (0 mismatches across 196 tensors).
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` written with the self-report, noting the "206 MB" input-size vs. output-size subtlety that determines the embeddings' shard placement.
